lines: - **Client-side payload extraction**: [`experimental.payloadExtraction`](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#payload-extraction-defaults-to-client) is `'client'`, inlining the payload in the HTML of a prerendered page

- **`clearNuxtState` resets to defaults**: `clearNuxtState` [resets state to its initial value](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#respect-defaults-when-clearing-usestate) instead of setting it to `undefined`
- **Early return from `navigateTo`**: A successful top-level `await navigateTo()` [stops the rest of your `setup()` running](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#early-return-from-navigateto)

+- **`noopener` for `navigateTo`**: Windows opened with `navigateTo(url, { open })` [get `noopener` by default](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#noopener-for-windows-opened-by-navigateto), so they cannot access `window.opener`

- **Server-side error boundaries**: `<NuxtErrorBoundary>` [catches errors thrown while server-rendering its default slot](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#nuxterrorboundary-catches-server-side-errors) instead of letting them reach the error page
- **Non-async `callHook`**: [`callHook` may return `void`](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#non-async-callhook) instead of always returning a `Promise`

- **Comment node placeholders**: Client-only components use [comment nodes instead of `<div>`](/docs/getting-started/upgrade#client-only-comment-placeholders) as SSR placeholders, fixing a scoped styles hydration issue

+`experimental.defaults.navigateTo.noopener` is now enabled by default, so [`navigateTo`](/docs/api/utils/navigate-to) with the `open` option passes `noopener` to `window.open` unless `open.windowFeatures.noopener` is set. The opened page can no longer access your application through `window.opener`, and a named `target` (other than `_self`, `_parent` and `_top`) opens a new window each time rather than reusing an existing one with that name.
+If an opened page relies on `window.opener` (for example, an OAuth popup that calls `window.opener.postMessage()`), or you reuse a named window, set `noopener: false` for that call:
+  open: { windowFeatures: { popup: true, noopener: false } },

+The `navigateTo.noopener` option controls whether [`navigateTo`](/docs/api/utils/navigate-to) passes `noopener` to `window.open` when called with the `open` option and `open.windowFeatures.noopener` is not set. This defaults to `true`.
